captions.detailed: This 3D model is a modular, four-corner card holder designed for tabletop gaming cards. It consists of four separate L-shaped corner brackets that frame the corners of a card deck, leaving large open gaps on all four sides for easy card drawing. Additionally, it features a trapezoidal male connector tab on one side to interlock with adjacent card holders.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric tabletop card holder with four corner brackets and optional interlocking connectors. Provide parameters to adjust the card length (card_y), card width (card_x), wall thickness, wall height, and toggles for connectors and custom logos.
captions.factory: The script constructs a base plate using a cube, which is modified by subtracting cylindrical cutouts and an optional logo. It features modular interlocking connectors using angled cuts on cubes. The four corner walls are created by translating and rotating eight individual cube primitives to form the four L-shaped bracket structures, allowing open access to the cards.
